r01.label: HarmonicStiction
r01.sticking: drive acceleration clipped to [-c, c] and weighted by 1 - tanh(omega/v)**2, next to Coulomb friction c*tanh(omega/v), v fitted (next to its lower bound); continuous in omega at 0

r02.label: TwoScaleStick
r02.sticking: drive acceleration clipped to [-c, c] and weighted by exp(-(omega/vs)**2), next to Coulomb friction c*tanh(omega/v), v and vs fitted; continuous in omega at 0

r03.label: HarmonicMotorAsymmetric
r03.sticking: projection branch domega = -omega/tau while the unprojected acceleration plus omega/tau lies within [-cn, cp], tau fitted; continuous in omega at 0

r04.label: AngleClip
r04.sticking: projection branch domega = -(b+k)*omega while the drive acceleration plus k*omega lies within the angle-dependent, direction-dependent friction limits, k fitted; continuous in omega at 0

r05.label: BlendedStiction
r05.sticking: blend with weight exp(-(omega/v)**2) of the net acceleration clipped to the capacity f*(1+h*cos(theta)) and sliding friction with tanh(omega/e), plus low-speed damping, v fitted (at its lower bound) and e fitted; continuous in omega at 0
